bio: Craig Greenberg (born August 22, 1973) is an American businessman, lawyer, and politician serving since 2023 as the third mayor of the consolidated city-county of Louisville, Kentucky. During his mayoral campaign, he was the target of an assassination attempt at his campaign headquarters, but emerged unscathed.
